correctness.rationale: Both brute-force enumeration and recursive generation agree on all 392 nonempty faces. A second quotient-of-Q5 construction independently matches the five-direction Cayley graph, whose degrees and (16,5,0,2) strongly regular parameters are checked. The deterministic 191-pair matching is pairwise disjoint; all 1200 Hasse edges are oriented and all 392 poset vertices topologically sorted, proving acyclicity. Exactly one critical 0-cell and nine critical 3-cells imply the stated integral homotopy wedge by the acyclic-matching theorem. The standard-library verifier additionally checks reduced Euler characteristic -9 and mod-two boundary ranks (15,65,95,16). No infinite or unaudited claims are made.

value.rationale: The 5-regular Clebsch graph is the canonical folded 5-cube and the 16-vertex strongly regular graph (16,5,0,2); its independence-complex homotopy is a natural exact invariant. Adding only the eight antipodal edges to Q4 changes the rank of third integral homology from the previously recorded seven to nine, which is not implied by known suspension theory or the graph spectrum. The complete reproducible integral homotopy classification supplies a meaningful natural test case for folded-hypercube topology, with no pretense of a family-wide theorem.
